captures.capture: lisbon in september. going to actually learn portuguese this time, not tourist phrases
starting the year with the dispossessed. le guin again. everyone says its the political one
duolingo day six. i can say the boy eats bread. lisbon will be thrilled
bin day is wednesday now not tuesday
got a starter from jules. feeding it one to one to one twice a day like the internet says
european portuguese is not brazilian portuguese and the app mostly teaches brazilian. found this out on day fifteen
first loaf. flat, dense, gummy in the middle. tasted like sad bread
anarres is the point. a whole society built on not owning anything and it still holds together. finished it in a week
they swallow the vowels. half the word just isnt there. reading it is easy, hearing it is a different language entirely
everyone says the answer is higher hydration. going to eighty percent. all the good loaves online are wet doughs
rent went up six percent. every month im paying someone elses mortgage. we have to buy
thirty day streak and i cannot form a sentence that wasnt on a card
dentist thurs 3pm, bring the old xrays
eighty percent dough is a puddle. cant shape it, it spreads on the peel like it gave up
picked up the magic mountain. seven hundred pages. everyone warns me about the middle
a streak measures showing up, not learning. i knew that about the gym and somehow not about this
wifi password is taped under the router
back to seventy. taller loaf but still a tight crumb. something else is wrong and it isnt water
got a tutor. rita, one hour a week on video. first session i said maybe forty words and sweated through a shirt
put the numbers in a spreadsheet. the deposit is five more years at this rate. thats the actual answer, not a feeling about it
bought a scale that reads tenths and a probe thermometer. measured dough temp for the first time, twenty one degrees. the book says twenty six
rita says stop translating in your head. i cannot find the off switch for that
page two hundred and ten of the magic mountain and nothing has happened for sixty pages. shelving it. not forever
return the blue jacket before the 14 day thing runs out
warm water changed more than hydration ever did. twenty six degree dough doubled in four hours instead of nine
the hour with rita is worth ten days of the app, and i still open the app because it is easier
moved the transfer to payday instead of whatever is left at month end. saved more in two months than in all of last year
first loaf with actual holes in it. did not change the recipe at all, only the temperature of the water
missed a session and paid for it anyway. that stung more than losing a sixty day streak would have
car service due at 60k, its at 57
watching a portuguese show with portuguese subtitles. im reading, not hearing. cheating with extra steps
overproofed it. left it six hours at twenty six because four was good so six must be better
audiobooks dont count as reading. i can feel myself being wrong about this and im saying it anyway
vocabulary is not the bottleneck. i know eight hundred words and can reach maybe sixty of them in real time
the poke test is useless to me. i genuinely cannot tell ready from forty minutes past ready
book the train for the 12th before the price goes up
skipped two weeks. no drama, just didnt open anything. thats how these end isnt it
book club picked something i would never have chosen. that is the entire value of a book club
index fund, monthly, boring. sam thinks i should pick stocks. i dont have an edge and neither does sam
weighing the dough before and after bulk now. twenty percent rise, not double. thats the number im going with instead of a feeling
restarted duolingo from zero because losing the streak reset something in my head. thats a strange amount of power to hand an owl
milk, eggs, tinfoil, whatever is on the fridge list
last session with rita. told them it was just for the summer. it was not just for the summer
summer kitchen is twenty nine degrees and everything is fast and sour in a way i dont like. acetic versus lactic something
the honest version. i wanted to have learned portuguese. i did not want to spend an hour a day being bad at it
text the plumber back about the boiler noise
skipped two weeks. starter survived in the fridge under a layer of grey liquid. poured it off, two feeds, completely fine
the only phrases that stuck are the ones i needed in a real moment. ordering coffee, asking where a thing is. context beats repetition and no app can hand me context from a sofa in another country
new rule, thirty pages then out. finishing books i dont like was making me read less not more
the fee difference over thirty years is a car. moved everything into the cheapest tracker and stopped reading about it
loaf for jules birthday was the best one yet and i cannot tell you what i did differently. that is the maddening part
passport expires march, renew it in january
reading about retarding. shape it then fridge overnight. supposedly easier to score and better flavour
seat 14c, gate closes 40 min before
first fridge retard, fourteen hours. scored like butter, the blade did not drag once. this is the unlock
lisbon. everyone switched to english within one sentence and i let them. two people didnt and those two conversations are the only portuguese i actually did
the retard also means i bake in the morning instead of at eleven at night. the method that fits your day is the method you actually keep
home a week and its already going. use it or lose it isnt a slogan, its a decay curve
the urgency about buying is mostly my parents voice. noticed it halfway through writing an email about a viewing
the left hand of darkness. second le guin this year. nobody else writes cold like that
tried twenty four hours in the fridge. too sour and the crust stayed pale. fourteen to sixteen is the window
cancel the streaming thing they charged again
mums birthday the 23rd, dont wing it this year
wrote the whole method on an index card taped inside the cupboard door. seventy percent, twenty six degree dough, twenty percent rise, shape, fifteen hours fridge, two fifty oven
reading fiction at lunch instead of scrolling. twenty minutes a day is apparently fifteen books a year
printer needs the 405 cartridges not the 404
three loaves in a row that look like each other. that has never happened before
checked the balance far too often this year. every check made me want to do something, and doing something is how you lose
christmas loaf failed. rushed the bulk because people were arriving. no method survives a schedule
counted nineteen books. felt like fewer. the ones i remember are the four i argued with someone about
gym contract ends feb, decide before it auto renews
keep losing touch with people i actually like. what if something just told me you havent spoken to marisol since october. tiny app. call it pigeon
new year and no language resolution. last january i was three days into a plan that lasted six months and left me with sixty usable words
pigeon rule: never guilt you. no streaks no red badges no counts. one card a day, ignore it and nothing happens
trying a stiff starter because a video said better structure. so far it does nothing i can see and it is more work
sketched the pigeon data model on the train. person, last contact, and a cadence you set per person instead of one global setting
viewing on saturday. small flat, forty five minute commute, and the mortgage payment is thirty percent above our rent for less space
going with firebase for pigeon. dont want to write a backend for a thing four people will use. auth plus firestore and im shipping in a month
pigeon auth working in twenty minutes. firebase really is fast for the first twenty minutes
three books about cities in a row and by the third i noticed they were all citing the same two studies
the whole product is the per person cadence. weekly for marisol, twice a year for old coworkers. thats the idea, the reminder is just plumbing
dropped the stiff starter after four weeks. back to the card. the video was not lying, it just wasnt my problem
importing the address book on day one makes it feel like a growth app. maybe you add people by hand and the friction is the filter
parcel is at the shop on the corner til friday
showed pigeon to marisol. they immediately asked if it can send the text for you. no. you texting is the entire point
did the rent versus buy maths properly, with maintenance and insurance and the interest split. renting is not throwing money away. i have been repeating a line i never once checked
firestore offline is fine until it isnt. two devices, stale write wins, lost my own test data. shrugging at it for now
get the spare key cut, two copies
hand entry was right. eleven people in mine and every one is someone i actually want to see
twenty percent whole wheat is the most flavour per unit of risk. forty and the thing is a brick
abandoned two books this month without a flicker of guilt. a year ago that would have kept me up
nudge copy is just marisol, four months. no verb no exclamation. it should read like a fact not a chore
spent the weekend on a settings screen nobody needs. the app has three settings and i built a framework for thirty
testflight build out to four people. embarrassing how much i care about a thing four people use
what i actually want from buying is not being asked to leave. thats security, not an investment. those are two different products and i kept buying the wrong one
the eighty percent hydration thing from last february was me copying photographs. wet dough is a result of good handling, not a cause of it
jules says the nudge feels like a to do because it sits in a list. maybe it shouldnt be a list at all. one card, swipe, gone
opticians called, glasses ready
killed the list view. one card only. app is forty percent less code and better
someone at work is learning greek by only talking. no app no book. sounds awful and is obviously more correct than what i did
firebase bill this month eleven cents. fine. but i noticed im designing around firestore query shapes instead of around what the app should do
reread the first forty pages of the dispossessed on a train. shevek is much lonelier than i remembered. i read it as a political book and it might be a book about a marriage
app store search says there are already two things called pigeon and one is a delivery app with a hundred thousand installs
jules asked for the recipe and i sent a photo of the index card. felt like handing over something real instead of a link
thinking about a rename and i hate it. the name is half the reason i kept working on this
pay the water bill, they only take card on the phone
sync bug again. two phones, one says contacted, the other doesnt. its not the firestore rules, its my model. last write wins is the wrong rule for this
hit a number in the index fund that i wrote down in 2023 as a five year target. mostly the market, not me
if i started this today i would put a sqlite file on the phone and sync nothing. one user one device. i picked firebase to go fast and it is what made me slow
summer again and the dough is moving fast. this year i just use colder water instead of panicking. twenty in, still lands at twenty six
name shortlist. halloway is a street near my grandmothers house. checked, nobody owns it, no app, no trademark
hotel confirmation number is in the other email account
book club argument about whether a book can be good if you hate the narrator. i said yes, went home, and thought no
its halloway now. renamed the repo the bundle id the testflight everything. felt like a funeral for about two hours and then it was fine
halloway keeps the one card rule. the name changed, the no guilt thing did not
explaining it is harder now. pigeon told you what it did in one word. halloway needs a whole sentence
the tap washer is a half inch, take the old one to the shop
halloway v1 is in the store. four users, three of whom live within a mile of me
review from a stranger, nice but why cant i see a history. because a history is a scoreboard and a scoreboard is the thing i built this to avoid
market dropped eight percent in three days and i felt it in my stomach, which means my risk tolerance is lower than the questionnaire said it was
sold a chunk into cash. told myself it was rebalancing. it was fear with a spreadsheet on top of it
the per person cadence from february is still the only original idea in here. everything else is a list app with better manners
the magic mountain is still on the shelf face out. a year and a half of being judged by a book
firebase still costs nothing and i still write code to work around offline sync every single week. this is the tax i signed up for in january
stopped feeding twice a day. once, cold, before bed. the starter is happier and i think about it much less
chase the landlord about the window latch
started ripping firebase out. sqlite on device, a json export, no accounts at all
no accounts means no password reset no support inbox no privacy policy questions. deleting the login screen deleted a third of the app
it recovered in five weeks and i was in cash for four of them. the cost of that decision is now a number i can look at whenever i feel clever
flu jab, walk in on saturdays
local only build opens instantly. i had gotten used to a nine hundred millisecond cold start and decided that was normal
the fridge thing is a year old now and it is still the only step i would never take out
the hand entry decision back in march is why the local only version works at all. eleven rows never needed a cloud
listened to a whole book on a long drive and i remember more of it than the last thing i read on paper. i was snobbish and wrong about this
marisol asked why it changed names. told them the pigeon story. they said the old one sounded like a game. maybe the rename was right and i was just grieving
new rule. nobody sells, including me. the transfer goes out on payday and i look at it once a quarter
three months in i open it about twice a week and text someone maybe half those times. thats a real hit rate for something with no notifications
clocks go back sunday
thinking about what this was actually for. it was january and id realised i hadnt spoken to anyone outside work since october
le guin essays. the carrier bag one. changed how i think about plot more than any craft book has
order the thing for dads christmas before it sells out
shipped the sqlite version. nine weeks to undo a decision that took twenty minutes to make
someone at work asked how long it takes to learn this. two years, and the actual answer fits on an index card
its done. not abandoned, done. it does the one thing. i keep opening the repo looking for work and there isnt any
sam wants to buy again. i said the maths doesnt work, heard my own certainty, and didnt like the sound of it. i was exactly this certain the other way two years ago
office closed the 24th to the 2nd
note for the next side project. pick the boring local storage, name it something nobody owns, and search the store before you get attached
second christmas loaf. started thursday for a sunday lunch. the fridge does the waiting so i dont have to
sixteen books. fewer than last year and a much better year of reading
two years on i can still read a portuguese menu and understand nothing anyone says. the gap between reading and hearing never closed at all
insurance renewal quote is 40 higher, ring them
take the recycling out, the green one this week
picked up the magic mountain again, from page one. two years later and the slow middle is the reason to read it. the whole book is about time not passing
landlord is selling. two months notice. the security thing i wrote about last april is not abstract any more
someone at work described an app that is basically halloway with streaks. i said no streaks and couldnt explain why in one sentence. the reason is a year old
train replacement bus on sundays until april
finished mann. forty three days. the last hundred pages i read like a thriller
new place, rent nine percent higher, worse kitchen. renting is fine holds up financially and costs something the spreadsheet has no column for
havent baked since february and feel nothing about it. the card is on the cupboard for whenever i want it
battery in the smoke alarm, it beeped again at 4am
the thirty page rule nearly cost me that book. abandoning early is right most of the time and wrong in exactly the cases that matter most
collect the dry cleaning, ticket is in the coat
if i ever do this again. a tutor from week one, no app, and go somewhere i cant leave
reopened the rent versus buy spreadsheet with todays rates. buying now wins in year nine instead of year fourteen. same maths, different world
reread the dispossessed properly. it is far harder on anarres than i remembered. le guin is not selling the utopia, the utopia is the thing being put under stress
vet appointment moved to the 9th
walking plus an audiobook is half my reading now. the format was never the problem, sitting still was
third le guin read. at some point favourite author stops being a taste and becomes a place you go back to
charger left at the office, its the short white one
opened halloway for the first time in months and it still works because there is no server that could have died. thats the whole argument for the boring choice
saving for a deposit again. not because renting is throwing money away, that was never true. because i want to choose when i move
baked for the first time in months, straight off the card, and it came out right. the method holds even when i dont
book club voted to stop meeting after two years. the argument about the unlikeable narrator is the thing i will actually remember
boiler service, they said any weekday morning
a year of only looking once a quarter. no decisions made at all, and the best year of returns ive had
renew the library card, it expired in august
reading slower on purpose. twelve books this year and i could tell you the shape of every one
someone at a meetup asked what stack for a tiny app. said sqlite and no accounts. they asked why not firebase and i realised i now answer that question with a story about a bird
three years of notes about money and only two of them mattered. automate the transfer, and know what you are actually buying
three year count, nineteen then sixteen then twelve. the number went down every year and the reading got better every year
